title: upstream crosslink: init --update clobbers adopter customizations inside the managed .gitignore block without warning
description: Observed in this repo's 2026-07-20 install repair: the root .gitignore's crosslink-managed block carried a deliberate, comment-documented adopter customization (carve-outs keeping vsdd-prefixed artifacts in .claude/hooks|commands|mcp tracked as source — this repo IS the toolkit those directories deploy from). init --update replaced the block with the canonical form silently: no warning, no diff surfaced, no refusal — in a tool whose own managed-file discipline elsewhere is drift-refusal. Same defect family as vsdd-cli #431 (settings merge clobbers the hooks block wholesale): merge paths that overwrite adopter-owned intent without surfacing it. Suggestion: treat an adopter-modified managed block like a drifted managed file — refuse and print the diff, or three-way merge with the customization preserved and a conflict surfaced. Evidence: this repo's working-tree diff of .gitignore, 2026-07-20 (pre-commit state recorded on vsdd-cli #597's trail); restoration ruling recorded the same day.
